references.text: The parallel account in Numbers where the Lord hears Israel's complaints and swears that the rebellious generation will not see the promised land.
The Lord's oath that those who grumbled against him would not enter the land, except for Caleb and Joshua.
A reference to the fulfillment of the Lord's oath, where the entire warrior generation died in the wilderness as the Lord had sworn.
The psalmist quotes the Lord's oath in his anger that the people will not enter into his rest.
Hebrews quotes Psalm 95:11 and refers to the Lord's oath that the rebellious will not enter into his rest.
Hebrews reflects on the wilderness generation whom God was angry with, and whom he swore would not enter into his rest because of their disobedience.
